grammar_title: 定语从句3:介词+关系代词(in which/for whom)· 非限制性定语从句 · which 指代整个主句
source: 外研社版(新标准)必修第一册 Unit 6 Using language:Attributive clauses (3)。介词+whom/which、非限制性定从、which 指代整句。句子地道、答案唯一(靠搭配介词与 which/whom/who 的人物匹配排除其他项)。

points.point: 介词 + which / whom(in which / for whom)
points.overview: 关系代词指物用 which、指人用 whom;介词由从句中的动词或名词搭配决定(grow rice in / learn from / depend on / home to)。指人时介词后只能 whom,指物时只能 which。

points.point: 非限制性定语从句(逗号 + which / who / whose)
points.overview: 逗号隔开、对先行词作补充说明:指物用 which、指人用 who、所属用 whose;非限制性定从中绝不可用 that。

points.point: which 指代整个主句(…, which means …)
points.overview: 逗号后的 which 指代前面整句话的内容、在从句中作主语;此处只能用 which,that / what / it / this 都不能引导这类从句。

questions.stem: The terraces created flat areas ____ the local people could grow rice.
questions.explanation: grow rice in areas、先行词指物 → 介词 in + which。

questions.stem: He was an expert ____ the Zhuang people learnt a great deal about farming.
questions.explanation: learn a great deal from sb、先行词指人 → from + whom。

questions.stem: These terraces still mean a lot to the local people ____ old traditions hold much value.
questions.explanation: traditions hold value for sb、先行词指人 → for + whom。

questions.stem: The sun warms the water and forms clouds ____ rain falls onto the terraces again.
questions.explanation: rain falls from clouds、先行词指物 → from + which。

questions.stem: The Zhuang and Yao are the people ____ this mountain region has long been home.
questions.explanation: the region is home to sb、先行词指人 → to + whom。

questions.stem: Farmers admire the clever way ____ people work in harmony with nature.
questions.explanation: the way in which 是固定结构、先行词指物 → in + which。

questions.stem: She has kind neighbours ____ she shares the rice harvest every autumn.
questions.explanation: share sth with sb、先行词指人 → with + whom。

questions.stem: The reef is a giant structure ____ many sea creatures depend for food and shelter.
questions.explanation: depend on sth、先行词指物 → on + which。

questions.stem: Climate change is a serious problem ____ many scientists are deeply worried.
questions.explanation: be worried about sth、先行词指物 → about + which。

questions.stem: Guides look after the visitors ____ they prepare a safe path up the steep hill.
questions.explanation: prepare sth for sb、先行词指人 → for + whom。

questions.stem: The Turpan Basin is the region ____ the sweetest grapes in China are grown.
questions.explanation: grapes are grown in the region、先行词指物 → in + which。

questions.stem: The young farmers respect the elders ____ they have learnt the ancient methods.
questions.explanation: learn sth from sb、先行词指人 → from + whom。

questions.stem: Those without a garden can rent small pieces of land ____ they grow vegetables.
questions.explanation: grow things on the land、先行词指物 → on + which。

questions.stem: The walls of the drying houses have many holes ____ the desert wind can pass.
questions.explanation: wind passes through holes、先行词指物 → through + which。

questions.stem: The Inuit are the northern people ____ the frozen Arctic has always been home.
questions.explanation: the Arctic is home to sb、先行词指人 → to + whom。

questions.stem: The Arctic is one of the few cold zones ____ very few plants can survive.
questions.explanation: survive in the zones、先行词指物 → in + which。

questions.stem: We warmly thanked the local guide ____ we explored the deep, narrow valley.
questions.explanation: explore with sb、先行词指人 → with + whom。

questions.stem: The huge waterfall is the very feature ____ Huangguoshu National Park is famous.
questions.explanation: be famous for sth、先行词指物 → for + which。

questions.stem: The Channel Tunnel is a long rail tunnel, most ____ runs deep under the sea.
questions.explanation: most of the tunnel、先行词指物 → of + which。

questions.stem: The children listened to the old farmer ____ they heard the story of the terraces.
questions.explanation: hear sth from sb、先行词指人 → from + whom。

questions.stem: The Longji Rice Terraces, ____ were built over many centuries, attract thousands of visitors.
questions.explanation: 非限制性定从、先行词指物、逗号后不可用 that → which。

questions.stem: The Zhuang people, ____ have farmed these mountains for generations, live close to nature.
questions.explanation: 非限制性定从、先行词指人作主语 → who。

questions.stem: The Great Barrier Reef, ____ lies off the coast of Australia, is the largest living structure.
questions.explanation: 非限制性定从、先行词指物、不可用 that → which。

questions.stem: We met an old farmer, ____ family has kept the terraces for hundreds of years.
questions.explanation: 后面跟名词 family、表所属 → whose。

questions.stem: Natural dyes, ____ people make from plants and minerals, are becoming popular again.
questions.explanation: 非限制性定从、先行词指物作宾语、不可用 that → which。

questions.stem: Emma, ____ is now travelling in Guizhou, sent a video of a huge waterfall.

questions.stem: The Grand Canyon, ____ is almost two kilometres deep, is a truly grand sight.

questions.stem: Victoria Falls, ____ local name means 'the smoke that thunders', lie between two countries.
questions.explanation: 后面跟名词 name、表所属(物亦可用 whose)→ whose。

questions.stem: My grandfather, ____ loves gardening, spends every Sunday among his flowers.

questions.stem: Herbal tea, ____ many British people drink to relax, has several health benefits.

questions.stem: The author of The Secret Garden, ____ book was published in 1911, loved nature.
